title: Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) Institutional Investors Sentiment Index Improved in Q3 2018
text:
Posted by Winifred Garcia 31 pm Sentiment for Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO)
Cisco Systems Inc (NASDAQ:CSCO) institutional sentiment increased to 0.85 in Q3 2018 . Its up 0.01, from 0.84 in 2018Q2. The ratio is better, as 664 active investment managers increased or started new stock positions, while 781 decreased and sold equity positions in Cisco Systems Inc. The active investment managers in our partner’s database reported: 3.15 billion shares, down from 3.26 billion shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of active investment managers holding Cisco Systems Inc in their top 10 stock positions increased from 198 to 222 for an increase of 24. Sold All: 53 Reduced: 728 Increased: 525 New Position: 139.
Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells Internet Protocol based networking and other products related to the communications and information technology industry worldwide. The company has market cap of $203.44 billion. The firm offers switching products, including fixed-configuration and modular switches, and storage products that provide connectivity to end users, workstations, IP phones, wireless access points, and servers; and next-generation network routing products that interconnect public and private wireline and mobile networks for mobile, data, voice, and video applications. It has a 172.71 P/E ratio. It also provides collaboration products comprising unified communications products, conferencing products, collaboration endpoints, and business messaging products; data center products, such as blade and rack servers, series, fabric interconnects, and management software solutions; wireless products consisting of wireless access points, WLAN controllers, cloud and appliances based services, and integrated software services.
The stock decreased 1.24% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $45.25. About 4.31 million shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 25.29% uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.29% the S&P500.
Analysts await Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) to report earnings on February, 13. They expect $0.65 earnings per share, up 12.07 % or $0.07 from last year’s $0.58 per share. CSCO’s profit will be $2.92B for 17.40 P/E if the $0.65 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.68 actual earnings per share reported by Cisco Systems, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -4.41 % negative EPS growth.
